你的任务：在 Obsidian vault 中修改一个笔记文件，向文件末尾追加一个新章节。

文件路径（相对于 vault 根目录，即你的工作目录）：TOEFL/邮件写作/真题/餐厅issue.md

步骤：
1. 先用 Read 工具读取该文件的完整内容。
2. 用 Edit 工具，在文件末尾（「# 范文」章节的最后一句话 "A satisfied customer" 之后）追加以下新内容。注意：在 "A satisfied customer" 那行之后需要有一个空行，然后追加下面的内容。不要改动文件中的任何现有内容。

需要追加的内容（原样复制，包括空行和缩进）：

# Issue 补充

> [!note] 用途
> 备考写作短语库：Issue → 解决办法

## 食物类
- 菜品与菜单不符 → 更新菜单照片与描述
- 太咸 / 太淡 / 没熟 / 烧焦 → 重做或更换菜品
- 食物中有异物 → 重做并免单
- 上桌时已凉 → 加快传菜速度
- 分量偏少 → 统一出餐标准
- 忌口 / 过敏需求未满足 → 下单时标注并确认

## 服务类
- 上菜太慢 → 高峰期加派人手
- 服务员态度差 → 加强员工培训
- 上错菜 / 漏单 → 下单后复述订单确认
- 难叫到服务员 → 高峰期增派人手
- 服务员不熟悉菜品 → 定期菜品培训

## 环境类
- 桌面脏 → 餐前加强清洁检查
- 餐具不干净 / 缺失 → 餐前检查并补齐
- 空调过冷 / 过热 → 调节室温
- 灯光太暗 → 调亮灯光
- 油烟味重 → 改善通风系统
- 预订后无座位 / 等位久 → 完善预订系统

## 账单类
- 账单多算钱 → 核对账单后退差价
- 刷卡机故障 → 备用 POS 机 / 提前告知顾客
- 菜价与标价不符 → 更新菜单价格

完成后报告：你追加了哪个章节、追加位置是否正确、原内容是否保持未动。

9	You recently dined at a local restaurant near campus and were impressed overall. However, you experienced some issues with the dining experience. You want to contact the restaurant manager, Ms. Miller, to address these issues.

19	# 回答
20	
21	Dear Ms. Miller, 
22	I visited your restaurant recently. It was an enjoyable experience. I loved the quiet atmosphere, and the food <mark style="background: #FFB8EBA6;">tastes</mark> good. 
23	However, I didn't bring enough money, so I didn't pay for my meal. Thanks for your understanding again.

28	# 原文改写
29	
30	Dear Ms. Miller,
31	I visited your restaurant recently. It was an enjoyable experience. I loved the quiet atmosphere, and the food tasted good.
32	However, I didn't bring enough money, so I didn't pay for my meal. Thanks for your understanding again.
33	Could you please send my bill to me? Then I will pay my bill by card. Please let me know if you need further information from me.
34	Best regards,
35	Tom

37	# 范文
38	
39	Dear Ms. Miller,
40	I am writing to share feedback on my visit to your restaurant last Friday evening. I was genuinely impressed by the warm atmosphere and the attentive service from our waiter, who **checked on us several times**. The **grilled salmon** I ordered was cooked perfectly, and the **lemon sauce** was delicious.
41	However, I did experience two issues. First, our table was near the kitchen door, and the constant traffic made it quite noisy. Second, my friend's pasta arrived almost **fifteen minutes after** the rest of our meals, so we could not eat together.
42	I would suggest adding a <mark style="background: #FFB8EBA6;">partition</mark> near the kitchen entrance to reduce the noise, and having the kitchen coordinate orders for the same table so all dishes are served at once. I hope this feedback is helpful, and I look forward to dining with you again.
43	Sincerely,
44	A satisfied customer
